Name: Monika Valley Story - Monika in Doki Doki Literature Club
Author: MasterDG
Description:
[size=4][b]模组介绍/Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b] [/b][/color]
    Monika Valley Story 是一个基于 Content Patcher 制作的模组，本模组将《Doki Doki Literature Club!》中的人气角色——文学部部长 Monika 带入了星露谷，使其成为一位完全可攻略的 NPC。
    Monika Valley Story is a Content Patcher mod that brings Monika — the beloved Literature Club president from Doki Doki Literature Club! — into Stardew Valley as a fully romanceable NPC.

[size=4][b]安装说明/ Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [b]SMAPI[/b] 并用它启动一次游戏/Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and run the game once with it. ([url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io[/url]) [/*]
[*]安装 [b]Content Patcher[/b] /Install [b]Content Patcher[/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]).[/*]
[*]下载本模组，把 [b][u]Monika Valley Story[/u][/b] 文件夹解压到 [u][b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b][/u] 目录下。
Download this mod and extract the Monika Valley Story folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via [b]SMAPI[/b] — Monika will be waiting for you at the bus stop![/*]
[/list][b]    前置要求/Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.x+, Content Patcher 2.8.0+
[b]    语言/Languages:[/b] 简体中文 / English(for now).

[size=4][b] 声明/Disclaimer[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]    本模组是一个非商业性质的二创项目。Monika 及所有相关角色均为《Doki Doki Literature Club!》创作者 [i]Team Salvato[/i] 的知识产权。本模组与 Team Salvato 没有任何关联，也未获得其任何形式的认可或支持。[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]    本模组仅在多语言国际化翻译以及本地化工作时会使用AI智能体来辅助完成，模组内其余资产均为人工制作 [/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]    This mod is a non-commercial fan project. Monika and all related characters are the intellectual property of *Team Salvato*, creators of *Doki Doki Literature Club!*. This mod is not affiliated with or endorsed by Team Salvato in any way.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]   [/color]This mod uses AI agents only to assist with multilingual internationalization translation and localization. All other assets in the mod are manually created.

Downloads.Description:
修复了男性农夫与莫妮卡增添后代时提示收养而非生育的bug/Fixed a bug where the male farmer and Monika would prompt adoption instead of childbirth when adding a child.
修复了莫妮卡无法登上姜岛的bug/Fixed a bug where Monika could not go to Ginger Island.
增加了新的动作动画/Added new action animations.
